decisions.reason: The black-finish range applies a new surface to the firm's core drainage know-how and production. It was promoted from a mention to its own page in 2024, which suggests the firm reads its early results positively and can adapt it easily.

This shower channel for seamless coverings sits squarely within the firm's established shower-channel expertise. It has had a dedicated page in both years and fits the firm's strategy of modern, barrier-free bathrooms, so it is likely to stay.

The pump-drain channel looks like the firm took what it learned from withdrawn Product C, its earlier pump-assisted solution, and applied it, which reflects absorptive capacity in action. Pump technology lies further from the firm's core, so the risk is somewhat higher, but it is too new to drop.
